visualizerParams.title: Guided Practice: Sorting with a key Function
visualizerParams.description: sorted takes a key function that turns each item into the value to compare. A tuple key sorts by several criteria, and a minus sign reverses a numeric one.
visualizerParams.ghostCode:
students = [("Ravi", 72), ("Meena", 91), ("Kiran", 72), ("Asha", 91)]
by_marks = sorted(students, key=lambda s: (-s[1], s[0]))
print(by_marks)
print(max(students, key=lambda s: s[1])[0])
